```{r include=FALSE}

library(readxl)

samplesheet <- as.data.frame(read_xlsx(file.path(dir_gen,"output/Tables/Sex_adjusted_contin/Final_samplesheet_Continuous.xlsx")))

```

### -> sex-adjusted analysis

## FINAL SAMPLESHET OVERVIEW

### Sex
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
print(table(samplesheet$Sex))
```
### Phenotype
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
print(paste0("Minimum phenotype: ", min(samplesheet$pheno_cont)))
print(paste0("Maximum phenotype: ", max(samplesheet$pheno_cont)))
print(paste0("Median phenotype: ", median(samplesheet$pheno_cont)))
print(paste0("Mean phenotype: ", round(mean(samplesheet$pheno_cont), 3)))
print(paste0("sd phenotype: ", round(sd(samplesheet$pheno_cont), 3)))
```

### Age

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
print(paste0("Minimum age: ", min(samplesheet$Age)))
print(paste0("Maximum age: ", max(samplesheet$Age)))
print(paste0("Median age: ", median(samplesheet$Age)))
print(paste0("Mean age: ", round(mean(samplesheet$Age), 3)))
print(paste0("sd age: ", round(sd(samplesheet$Age), 3)))
print(paste0("IQR age: ", IQR(samplesheet$Age)))
```

### Ancestry
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
print(table(samplesheet$Ancestry))
```

### Phenotype boxpplot
```{r, out.width="300px", out.height="500px", message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(dir_gen,"output/Figures/Sex_adjusted_contin/Boxplot_phenotype_continuous.pdf"))
```
